phase_meta.summary: Wire Verra and Gold Standard into the app through a safe, incremental, standard-aware path. UNFCCC remains unchanged. The app consumes methodology metadata from the pack/manifest. Standard-specific composers come later, after the generic standard-aware path works.
current_focus: Freeze app-side expectations for provider, category, method code, version, display name, registry/standard label, and artifact paths (Phase 0)
Ensure the app consumes canonical manifest from the methodology pack, not hand-stitched entries (Phase 1)
not_active_now: Verra-specific or Gold Standard-specific report composers
Adding Verra/Gold Standard placeholder methods to the manifest
Changes to methodology pack data or encoding pipeline
Formal validation/verification claims for non-UNFCCC registries

phase_0_contract_and_boundaries.title: Contract and boundaries
phase_0_contract_and_boundaries.description: Freeze app-side expectations for provider, category, method code, version, display name, registry/standard label, and artifact paths. Document that article6-methodologies owns canonical methodology metadata and app.article6 consumes the methodology pack and renders workflows.
acceptance: All app-side contracts for provider, category, method code, version, display name, registry/standard label, and artifact paths are documented in PLAN.md
Boundary between article6-methodologies (canonical metadata owner) and app.article6 (consumer + workflow renderer) is clearly stated
No hand-stitched app-side manifest entries for Verra or Gold Standard exist yet
Existing UNFCCC consumption path is unchanged

phase_1_pack_manifest_consumption.title: Pack/manifest consumption
phase_1_pack_manifest_consumption.description: Ensure the app consumes the canonical manifest from the methodology pack. Avoid long-term hand-stitched app-side manifest entries. Preserve existing UNFCCC behavior.
acceptance: App reads manifest from the methodology pack path, not a hardcoded app-side list
No methodology metadata is duplicated or stitched on the app side
Existing UNFCCC method loading and project creation still works identically
phase_1_pack_manifest_consumption.visible_ui_change: None — internal architecture, no visible UI change

phase_2_standard_grouped_method_picker.title: Standard-grouped method picker
phase_2_standard_grouped_method_picker.description: Group methodology picker options by standard/provider. Preserve category grouping inside each standard where available. Make Verra and Gold Standard visible only when present in the manifest.
acceptance: Methodology picker groups options by standard/provider (UNFCCC, Verra, Gold Standard)
Category (Forestry, Energy, etc.) is displayed within each standard group
Verra and Gold Standard options only appear when the manifest contains entries with those providers
Existing project creation flow for UNFCCC methods is unchanged
phase_2_standard_grouped_method_picker.visible_ui_change: Methodology selection dropdown shows grouped options by standard/provider with category labels

phase_3_project_detail_registry_badge.title: Project detail registry badge
phase_3_project_detail_registry_badge.description: Show the selected standard/registry near the method code on the project detail page. Display standard, method, version, and category in a compact, reviewer-friendly way.
acceptance: Project detail page shows a registry/standard badge next to the method code
Badge clearly displays: UNFCCC, Verra, or Gold Standard
Method code and version remain visible alongside the badge
Category label is displayed when available from manifest data
UNFCCC badge does not regress — existing projects show it correctly
phase_3_project_detail_registry_badge.visible_ui_change: Project detail header shows a standard badge (e.g. "Verra" / "Gold Standard" / "UNFCCC") next to the method code and version

phase_4_generic_standard_aware_export_co.title: Generic standard-aware export composer
phase_4_generic_standard_aware_export_co.description: Add a generic standard-aware export/report composer that works for any known registry. Output truthful sections without claiming official Verra or Gold Standard validation or verification.
acceptance: Export produces a standard-aware report with sections: Project and Standard, Methodology Basis, Evidence Reviewed, Requirement Review, Gaps and Unsupported Claims, Reviewer Notes, Provenance and Export Metadata
Report does not claim official Verra or Gold Standard validation/verification
Existing UNFCCC-specific composer still dispatches correctly for UNFCCC projects
Generic composer is used for Verra and Gold Standard projects (and any future known registry)
Fallback/stub wording is removed from the export output for recognized registries
phase_4_generic_standard_aware_export_co.visible_ui_change: Verra and Gold Standard projects produce a structured report on export (instead of a fallback/stub notice)

phase_5_premium_pdf_wording_and_design.title: Premium PDF wording and design
phase_5_premium_pdf_wording_and_design.description: Replace fallback/stub wording for Verra and Gold Standard. Use Article6-branded readiness review language. Hide internal/debug language from user-facing PDF output.
acceptance: PDF export uses Article6-branded readiness review language for all known registries
No debug wording, internal provenance, or stub messages appear in the user-facing PDF
Registry-specific branding (logos, disclaimers) is not required — clean neutral design is sufficient
PDF design is consistent across UNFCCC, Verra, and Gold Standard exports
phase_5_premium_pdf_wording_and_design.visible_ui_change: Exported PDF for any known registry has polished wording and no stub/debug text

phase_6_quickcheck_standard_detection.title: QuickCheck standard detection hardening
phase_6_quickcheck_standard_detection.description: Harden detection for Verra, VCS, Verified Carbon Standard, VM/VMR prefixes, Gold Standard, GS4GG, and Gold Standard for the Global Goals in QuickCheck. Keep QuickCheck as routing/context support, not final truth.
acceptance: QuickCheck detects Verra (VCS, Verified Carbon Standard, VM prefix, VMR prefix) in uploaded documents
QuickCheck detects Gold Standard (GS4GG, Gold Standard for the Global Goals, GS prefix)
Detection is used for routing/context hints only, not as authoritative registry assignment
Existing UNFCCC detection is not regressed
Tests cover all new detection patterns
phase_6_quickcheck_standard_detection.visible_ui_change: QuickCheck may surface detected standard name in document analysis context

phase_7_standard_specific_composers_late.title: Standard-specific composers (future)
phase_7_standard_specific_composers_late.description: Document future Verra-specific and Gold Standard-specific composers. Do not implement until encoded metadata supports standard-specific sections. Keep this phase marked as planned, not active.
acceptance: Future Verra-specific composer requirements are documented in PLAN.md
Future Gold Standard-specific composer requirements are documented in PLAN.md
No implementation work is done in this phase
Phase status remains 'planned' until Verra/GS-specific metadata encoding is available upstream
